samples.title: Taxi ride, Frederiksted (St. Croix), 90 s
samples.about: A real taxi (a 15-seat van) through town to the cruise pier, filmed from beside the driver: parked cars, narrow streets, pedestrians on the pier. No GPS track. Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0, John Edwards; faces and plates blurred by us.

samples.title: Tashkent, 134 s along one street, phone in a car
samples.about: 120 photos a phone took about once a second while driving (Mapillary, CC BY-SA 4.0, contributor georgiysys; faces and plates blurred by Mapillary), one video frame per photo, with the phone's GPS. The phone-on-a-mount scenario of a taxi pilot.

samples.title: Dashcam, office district, 90 s
samples.about: A windscreen dashcam (140° lens) on city streets and an arterial road in strong sun and glare. No GPS track. Wikimedia Commons, CC0, Fernost; faces and plates blurred by us.

samples.title: City centre, Kraków, 90 s
samples.about: A car camera through Kraków's centre: tram tracks, parked cars on both sides, a queue behind an SUV. No GPS track. Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0, Relaxing Roads 4K; faces and plates blurred by us.
